description: "Meet the Robot Control Lab at The University of Texas at Dallas."

The **Robot Control Lab** at UT Dallas studies robotics, nonlinear control, and machine learning. Our group brings together mathematical modeling, optimization, and learning for robotic locomotion and manipulation.
